text: With the 'mananciais' decision rule applied (coder 1 UNCERTAIN recoded to WATER for Brazil), kappa is 0.832 with 90.1% agreement on 91 decisions.

location.locator: RESIDUAL_AUDIT.md section 5.2, primary result table; README.md validation summary

limitations: The second coder is an LLM operating under written decision rules, so this measures agreement with an LLM labeller, not human inter-coder reliability.
The 91-decision sample covers 71 Dutch and 20 Brazilian decisions only; no Canadian decisions.
The rule was defined after the disagreements were observed on the same sample, so 0.832 is a calibrated, in-sample figure rather than an independent estimate.
The figure is not stored in kappa_results.json, which contains only the baseline specification.
